jobs.title: Planning Engineer
jobs.description: The Planning Engineer is responsible for project planning, scheduling, monitoring, and progress control to ensure the successful delivery of infrastructure and construction projects. The role involves developing and maintaining project schedules, analyzing project performance, identifying risks and delays, and providing accurate progress reports to support effective decision-making. The Planning Engineer works closely with project managers, engineers, contractors, and clients to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. Develop, review, and monitor detailed project schedules for NDRC (Non-Disruptive Road Crossing) and associated infrastructure works. Review contractor baseline programmes, construction schedules, and project execution plans to ensure alignment with contractual milestones. Monitor actual project progress against approved schedules and identify delays, critical activities, and potential programme risks. Prepare and update weekly, monthly, and periodic progress reports highlighting project status and performance. Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and relevant stakeholders to obtain progress updates and ensure timely execution of project activities. Review construction methodologies, work sequences, and resource allocation to ensure efficient project delivery. Identify critical path activities and assess their impact on overall project completion milestones. Analyse project delays, identify root causes, and recommend appropriate corrective and recovery measures. Review and assess contractors' recovery programmes and mitigation plans to address project delays. Monitor manpower, equipment, and material resources against approved deployment and construction schedules. Prepare look-ahead programmes, including two-week, three-week, and monthly construction schedules. Track progress of NDRC activities, including utility diversions, trial pits, launching and receiving shaft construction, microtunnelling, pipe installation, and reinstatement works. Coordinate with the site supervision team to verify actual physical progress and ensure accurate progress reporting. Review contractors' progress claims and verify reported progress against actual site achievements. Prepare progress dashboards, S-curves, manpower histograms, and other project performance reports. Monitor project milestones, contractual deliverables, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Identify potential programme risks, construction constraints, and interface issues affecting project delivery. Maintain project records, planning documentation, progress trackers, and updated construction schedules. Assist the Resident Engineer in preparing project status reports and providing recommendations to the client and project management team. Ensure planning activities are aligned with Dubai Municipality (DM) requirements, project specifications, and contractual obligations. Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 10 years of experience in project planning and scheduling for infrastructure and construction projects. Proven experience in: Roads and highways projects Wet and dry utilities projects Buildings and master development projects Construction supervision and consultancy projects Strong expertise in project scheduling, resource planning, cost loading, and progress monitoring. jobs.title: Senior Road Engineer
jobs.description: ​​​​​​​The Senior Road Engineer is responsible for overseeing the design review, construction supervision, and delivery of road and highway infrastructure projects. The role ensures that all roadworks are executed in compliance with approved drawings, contract specifications, local authority requirements, quality standards, and health and safety regulations. The Senior Road Engineer coordinates with clients, contractors, utility authorities, and project stakeholders to ensure the successful completion of road infrastructure projects. Lead and manage the supervision of road construction and infrastructure works, ensuring compliance with approved drawings, project specifications, contractual requirements, and relevant authority standards. Provide technical guidance and support to road engineers, civil inspectors, and other supervision team members. Review and assess road design drawings, shop drawings, technical submissions, and construction methodologies. Supervise and monitor road construction activities, including earthworks, subgrade preparation, subbase, road base, asphalt paving, kerbstone installation, footpaths, interlock paving, and road markings. Review and verify road alignments, horizontal and vertical profiles, levels, gradients, cross-sections, and pavement design details. Ensure proper execution of excavation, filling, grading, compaction, and embankment works in accordance with approved specifications. Monitor asphalt production, transportation, laying, compaction, and testing to ensure compliance with approved mix designs and quality requirements. Review method statements, material submittals, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and other technical submissions related to roadworks. Coordinate with wet and dry utilities teams to resolve utility clashes, crossings, diversions, and interface issues affecting road construction. Review technical queries (RFIs), identify design discrepancies, and recommend appropriate engineering solutions. Monitor field and laboratory testing, including soil compaction, field density, plate load tests, asphalt core testing, and other required pavement tests. Ensure compliance with project QA/QC procedures, HSE requirements, and applicable RTA standards and regulations. Monitor construction progress against the approved programme and coordinate with the Planning Engineer to address delays and construction constraints. Coordinate with the Contractor, Resident Engineer, Client, and relevant authorities to resolve technical and construction-related issues. Review inspection requests, material inspection requests, and quality documentation to ensure compliance with project requirements. Prepare technical reports, progress updates, site observations, and recommendations for submission to the Resident Engineer and Client. Ensure proper coordination of roadworks with street lighting, signage, road marking, traffic signals, drainage, and other associated infrastructure. Monitor completion of road testing, snagging, reinstatement, and final handover activities in accordance with project requirements.   Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Identify defective workmanship, construction deviations, and non-conforming works and report them to the Structural Engineer. Maintain daily inspection records, site diaries, photographs, and progress reports. Follow up on NCRs, site observations, and corrective actions to ensure timely closure. Verify completed structural works, testing records, and as-built documentation prior to final inspection and handover. jobs.description: Job Summary The Planning Manager is responsible for leading all project planning, scheduling, monitoring, and reporting activities for large-scale infrastructure projects. The role ensures effective project controls by developing and maintaining integrated project programmes, monitoring progress, identifying risks, and supporting timely decision-making to achieve project objectives. The Planning Manager works closely with the Client, Project Director, Resident Engineers, contractors, commercial teams, and stakeholders to ensure accurate programme management throughout design, construction, testing & commissioning, handover, and project close-out. Key Job Duties 1. Project Planning & Scheduling Develop, maintain, and update the project master programme using Primavera P6 or equivalent planning software. Review and assess contractor baseline programmes, recovery plans, and revised schedules. Ensure programme compliance with contractual milestones and project objectives. Integrate design, procurement, construction, testing & commissioning, and handover activities into the project programme. 2. Progress Monitoring & Project Controls Monitor project progress against the approved baseline programme. Analyse schedule performance, critical paths, float consumption, and productivity trends. Identify delays and recommend corrective and recovery measures. Prepare look-ahead programmes and monitor milestone achievement. 3. Risk & Delay Management Identify programme risks and potential delays. Perform delay analysis and assess schedule impacts. Support the evaluation of Extension of Time (EOT) claims. Maintain programme risk registers and mitigation plans. 4. Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate planning activities with the Client, contractors, consultants, authorities, and utility providers. Participate in progress meetings, technical workshops, and project coordination meetings. Ensure alignment between planning activities and project execution. 5. Reporting & Performance Analysis Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports, executive dashboards, KPI reports, and management presentations. Produce programme updates, S-curves, earned value reports, manpower and equipment histograms, and productivity analyses. Present planning status and key issues to senior management and the Client. 6. Leadership & Team Management Lead and mentor project planning engineers. Establish planning procedures and reporting standards across the project. Promote continuous improvement in planning methodologies and project controls. Required Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. PMP, PMI-SP, or equivalent professional certification is preferred. Experience Minimum 15 years of planning and project controls experience, including at least 5 years as planning manager on major infrastructure projects. Proven experience in roads, utilities, drainage, public realm, transportation, and urban development projects. Strong background in construction supervision and consultancy environments. Experience with UAE infrastructure projects and authority requirements is highly desirable. Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Excel, and project controls software. Strong knowledge of FIDIC contracts, delay analysis techniques, EOT assessments, and project reporting. Experience preparing executive dashboards, KPIs, and schedule performance analyses. Familiarity with BIM, digital construction platforms, and document management systems is an advantage. Behavioural & Management Competencies Strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under demanding project schedules. High level of professionalism, accuracy, and commitment to continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Quantity Surveyor - Infrastructure
jobs.description: ​​​​​​​We are seeking a highly experienced Quantity Surveyor (Post Contract) to oversee all commercial, contractual, and cost management functions for major infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for quantity measurements, payment certifications, variation assessments, cost control, final accounts, and contractual administration, ensuring that project costs are effectively managed and contractual obligations are met throughout the project lifecycle. Review contract documents, BOQ, specifications, drawings, and scope of work to ensure compliance with contractual requirements. Verify and evaluate contractor's interim payment applications and monthly progress invoices. Carry out detailed quantity measurements and verify executed works at site. Prepare, review, and certify monthly progress payment statements and interim payment certificates. Monitor project quantities against the approved BOQ and identify any discrepancies or variations. Review and assess contractor's variation orders, including additional and omitted works. Evaluate claims related to additional costs, extension of time, and contractual entitlements. Prepare cost estimates for proposed variations, additional works, and design changes. Monitor project expenditure and ensure cost control throughout the project lifecycle. Review and verify daywork sheets, material invoices, and supporting documents submitted by the contractor. Maintain accurate records of measured quantities, payments, variations, and cost reports. Coordinate with the Resident Engineer, Construction Manager, Site Engineers, and Client regarding commercial and contractual matters. Review and assess contractor's final account submissions and verify quantities against actual executed works. Monitor the financial status of the project and prepare monthly cost and budget reports. Ensure that all payments and commercial submissions comply with contract conditions and project requirements. Identify potential commercial risks and advise the project management team on cost implications. Assist in preparing tender documents, BOQs, cost estimates, and technical-commercial evaluations. Verify as-built drawings and ensure final measured quantities reflect the actual completed works. Support the preparation of project close-out documents and final payment certificates. Ensure proper documentation and filing of all commercial correspondence, payment records, and contractual submissions. Bachelor's Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. jobs.title: Sales Executive
jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the role

As a Sales Executive at Careem, you will be driving day-to-day operations, strategic growth, and partner satisfaction. You will be the primary point of contact for partners/merchants, ensuring operational excellence, maximizing revenue across both delivery and scaling business performance Month-over-Month (MoM) and Quarter-over-Quarter (QoQ)

What you'll do

  • Present Careem’s marketplace and delivery solutions to prospective merchants.
  • Generate leads through cold calling, field visits, referrals, and networking.
  • Negotiate commercial terms, commissions, promotions, and partnership agreements.
  • Achieve monthly and quarterly sales/merchant acquisition targets.
  • Onboard new merchants and coordinate with internal teams to ensure successful activation.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, sales reports, and pipeline updates.
  • Analyze market trends and competitor activity to identify new business opportunities.
  • Work closely with Operations, Marketing, Finance, and Account Management teams.

What you'll need

  • 3+ years of experience in sales, business development, merchant acquisition, FMCG, retail, e-commerce, or food delivery.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.
  • Comfortable with field sales and meeting businesses in person.
  • Target-driven and able to work independently.
  • Good knowledge of the UAE retail/merchant market is an advantage.
  • English is usually required; Arabic can be an advantage.
  • A valid UAE driving license.

What we’ll provide you

We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:

  • Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
  • Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
  • Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
  • Work 4 days a week in office & 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
  • Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Associate - Shops
jobs.description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Operations Associate - Shops to own the performance of our Shops marketplace across the UAE and Jordan. This is a purely marketplace mandate so your world is Shops partners, their in-store picking teams, and the KPIs that determine a delightful customer experience. You'll sit at the intersection of Shops partners operations, strategic planning, and hands-on picking excellence.

What you'll do

  • Shops Partners Operations Performance. Own the end-to-end performance scorecard for Shops partners across UAE & JOR - order acceptance rate, prep time, order accuracy, cancellation rate, and customer contact rate and run the cadence that holds Shops accountable to it.
  • Strategic Planning & KPI Improvement. Translate performance gaps into a strategic roadmap: identify the top drivers of GMV leakage, AOV underperformance, and take-rate erosion, and build the initiatives that close them, from pilot to regional rollout.
  • Picking Operations Management. Manage the picking operation embedded within partner stores across UAE and Jordan - picker productivity, pick-to-pack time, and accuracy, including training standards, tooling, and process design that partners can actually run day-to-day.
  • Unit Economics. Build and defend the Last-Mile Unit Economics of every Shops partners cohort, working with Captain Operations to balance delivery cost, speed, and Captain earnings.
  • Business Reviews. Run quarterly and monthly business reviews with top Shops accounts, using cohort-level data (e.g., "Based on recent cohorts in Abu Dhabi and Amman...") to justify investment or intervention.
  • Peak Planning. Lead peak-season readiness planning for Ramadan and Dubai Shopping Festival - demand forecasting, Shops capacity planning, and picking-team surge staffing.

What you'll need

  • 1-3 years in operations, quick-commerce, last-mile logistics, or retail/e-commerce marketplace roles, with at least 2 years managing teams and external partners directly.
  • Experience managing frontline or in-store operations (picking, warehousing, fulfillment) - you've been on the floor, not just in the dashboard.
  • Strong data fluency (Excel/SQL and BI tools) paired with the judgment to know when a number needs a conversation, not just a chart.
  • Willingness to travel regularly between the UAE and Jordan.
  • Must be fluent in English; Arabic fluency is preferred
